definitions.full: H6593. pesheth [ מֵּ֫שֶׁת ] noun [masculine] flax, linen (√ dubious; Late Hebrew מִּשְׁתָּן , Punic φοιστ ; Löw p. 233 ); — suffix מִּשְׁתִּי Hosea 2:7 ; 2:11 ; elsewhere plural מִּעשׁתִּים Judg 15:14 +, construct מִּשְׁתֵּי Josh 2:6 ; — 1 flax , after gathering, הָעֵץ מִּשְׁתֵּי Josh 2:6 (J E, see עֵץ 2f ); inflammable Judg 15:14 (simile); as natural product (+ עֶמֶר ) Hosea 2:7 ; 2:11 ; as material, פ ׳מְּתִיל Ezek 40:3 ; of various garments Jer 13:1 ; Ezek 44:17-18 , (twice in verse), + צֶמֶר Deut 22:11 ; Lev 13:47-48 , 52 , 59 (P), compare Prov 31:13 ; פ ׳עֹבְדֵי שְׂרִיקוֺת Isa 19:9 (see [ שָׂרִיק ]).
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 6580 as in the sense of comminuting ;
